inputs.locator: Frozen economic policy: start each fair-reset window with 10,000 USDT; allocate 25 percent to long BTC spot and 75 percent to Binance USD-M futures collateral; short the perpetual in exactly the same BTC quantity; reset at quarter-start 01:00 UTC after the 00:00 funding event; liquidate fully at the window boundary. No leverage, threshold, venue, contract, allocation or clock scan is allowed.

Funding accounting and costs: a short receives quantity times official mark-price open times signed funding rate. NORMAL charges 10 bps fee plus 5 bps adverse slippage on each spot and perpetual side; STRESS charges 20 plus 10 bps. Conservative maintenance margin is 10 percent and the minimum required buffer is 2.0. The comparator is zero-yield cash with identical initial equity and window.

Frozen all-pass decision: Design 2020-2022, Validation 2023-2024, five annual fair resets and twenty quarterly fair resets must pass the preregistered return, funding-minus-cost, drawdown, Calmar, margin, liquidation, breadth, concentration, coverage and terminal-inventory gates. A valid failure permanently closes this exact family without tuning; a pass is historical only and cannot open OOS or activate Trading.

objective: Evaluate exactly one preregistered quarterly-reset Binance BTCUSDT delta-neutral funding-carry policy on the sealed checksum-verified 2020-2024 corpus. Run the frozen direct economic ledger twice under normal and stress two-leg costs; require byte-identical results and every Design, Validation, annual, quarter, drawdown, margin, concentration and terminal-inventory gate. Freeze a historical candidate only if all gates pass; otherwise permanently close the exact 25-percent-spot and 75-percent-collateral equal-quantity family without tuning. This is historical development evidence, not OOS or Trading authorization.

performance_case.causal_mechanism: A BTC spot long paired with an equal-quantity perpetual short removes most directional exposure while the short receives positive funding. Quarterly resets limit turnover, and 75-percent collateral is intended to keep basis-path margin risk conservative.
performance_case.claim_boundary: This task may establish only one pre-2025 historical Design and Validation decision for the exact Binance BTCUSDT quarterly-reset 25-percent-spot and 75-percent-futures-collateral equal-quantity carry policy. It cannot inspect post-2024 data, tune any economic setting, create Trading behavior, activate a strategy or open OOS.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: The policy is valuable only if funding exceeds all two-leg costs in both windows and broad fair-reset slices while normal and stressed drawdown, conservative margin buffer, basis path and terminal liquidation remain within frozen gates. Positive aggregate PnL alone cannot pass.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: One deterministic direct screen either creates a historical funding-carry candidate for independent sealed OOS or closes the exact family before allocation tuning, leverage experiments or runtime engineering consume research capacity.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: The exact quarterly-reset delta-neutral carry policy produces positive after-cost annualized return and low drawdown in Design and historical Validation, with at least four positive years, broad positive quarters, limited top-year concentration and no liquidation.

decision_time.availability_rule: Every hourly spot, contract, mark and index price and each funding rate comes only from publisher-checksummed pre-2025 archives. Quarter-start execution uses the 01:00 UTC open only after the 00:00 funding observation; no later bar or post-2024 observation is available to a decision.
